current_evidence: The council's Validation checklists page (last updated 26 August 2025) links only the 'Validation checklist 2024' and 'Validation checklist explanatory notes 2024' and says they were 'adopted on 19 June 2024 following a 6 week public consultation'; a search found no later list or consultation.

issues.detail: The List date is given as 2024-06-01, but the document and the council page give the adoption date as 19 June 2024. The workbook's own Date basis quotes 'adopted by the Council on 19th June 2024', so the date column does not match it.
issues.evidence: Explanatory Notes: 'adopted by the Council on 19th June 2024'; web page: 'adopted on 19 June 2024 following a 6 week public consultation'

issues.detail: The workbook links the Explanatory Notes but not the companion Validation Checklist 2024 (https://assets.ctfassets.net/ii3xdrqc6nfw/5OsHmHp7hxs9wLgC1POywU/f0ae22d4c97d9304d58a3f9b370134a4/Validation_Checklist_2024.pdf). Only the checklist says which local requirements apply to which of the 12 application types. Grokbot read it but did not use it to assign application types. (Note: that checklist's introduction still contains the old sentence 'adopted on 22nd April 2019', although its cover is dated 2024.)
issues.evidence: Checklist 2024 structure: twelve application types, each with a 'National Requirements' list and a 'Local Requirements' list

issues.detail: Many tab_items come from superseded or non-local sources instead of the 2024 list. Items 0, 5 and 6 come from the superseded April 2019 checklist. Items 2-4 and 14-21 come from DCLG's 2010 national guidance (assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/.../1505220.pdf), for example 'original plus three copies (a total of four copies)' and 'CD or USB storage device'. These are not Stockport's local requirements.
issues.evidence: tab_items sources: Validation_Checklist_April_2019.pdf and 1505220.pdf (DCLG 'Guidance on information requirements and validation', 2010)

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the 2024 checklist gives Householder a full local list. It includes the House Extension Energy Efficiency Checklist, Airport Safeguarding Information, Ecological Assessment / Protected Species Survey, Coal Mining Risk Assessment, Conservation Area / Listed Building Appraisal / Heritage Statement, Contaminated Land Survey, Flood Risk Assessment, Green Belt Justification, Green Belt Volume Calculation, Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment, Other Plans and Drawings, Photographs, Planning Statement, Referencing and Scaling of Plans, Statement of Community Involvement, Sunlight/Daylight Assessment and Tree Survey.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist 2024, Householder 'Local Requirements' list; Explanatory Notes: 'HOUSE EXTENSION ENERGY EFFICIENCY CHECKLIST... changes to existing domestic dwellings'

issues.detail: Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Lawful development cert, Prior approval, S73 variation, Discharge of conditions and Non-material amendment are all recorded as '(none)', but the checklist gives each of them local requirements. Reserved Matters has almost the same local list as Full. LBC has Airport Safeguarding, Heritage Statement, Energy Statement, FRA, Lighting, Structural Survey, Tree Survey, Photographs and Planning Statement. LDC has existing/proposed elevations and floor plans, an existing site survey plan, sworn affidavits, Photographs and Planning Statement. Prior Notification has Biodiversity, Contaminated Land, FRA, Landscaping, Noise, Structural Survey, Transport Assessment and Tree Survey. Removal/Variation of Condition has most of the Full list plus Foul Sewerage Details and Landscaping Details. Approval of Details has Planning Statement, Referencing and Scaling, and Location Plan. NMA has Referencing and Scaling.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist 2024, sections for Reserved Matters, Listed Building Consent, Lawful Development Certificate, Prior Notification, Non-Material Amendment, Removal or Variation of Condition and Approval of Details

issues.detail: About 40 requirements are placed only under Full planning with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning'. The checklist does name the types. For example, the Tree Survey applies to F, RM, O, H, LB, PN and RC. The Heritage Statement applies to F, RM, O, H, LB and RC. Sunlight/Daylight applies to F, RM, O, H and RC. The Flood Risk Assessment applies to F, RM, O, H, LB, PN and RC. Contaminated Land is placed only under Outline, but it applies to F, RM, O, H, PN and RC.
issues.evidence: Validation Checklist 2024 local requirement lists per application type

issues.detail: Under Works to trees, Grokbot records 'Floor plans / Elevations (existing and proposed)', using text taken from the 2010 national guidance about elevations and boundary treatments. Neither Stockport list applies this to tree works applications. The checklist does not cover tree works at all.
issues.evidence: Trigger source 1505220.pdf: 'information on elevations of existing buildings on the site if these will not be altered...'

issues.detail: Several local requirements in the 2024 list are missing from app_type_rows. These are: the House Extension Energy Efficiency Checklist (changes to existing dwellings, Householder); Green Belt Justification (inappropriate development in the Green Belt, needing a very special circumstances case); Green Belt Volume Calculation (extensions or replacement buildings in the Green Belt); and Airport Safeguarding Information (sites in the Manchester Airport safeguarding zones, bird-attracting or aviation uses, and buildings above 15m, 45m or 90m depending on the zone). Also missing are the Hazardous Installations Risk Assessment, Pollution Statement (development that could pollute), Road Safety Audit and Designer's Response, and Other Plans and Drawings (street scenes, demolition plans etc.). VU.City Information (major new build of 50+ dwellings or 2,500 sq m+, needing a 3D massing model) appears only as a 'Submission rules' tab item and not as a requirement.
issues.evidence: Explanatory Notes 2024 headings: 'House Extension Energy Efficiency Checklist', 'Green Belt Justification', 'Green Belt Volume Calculation', 'Airport Safeguarding', '31. Hazardous Installations (Risk Assessment)', '37. Pollution Statement', 'Road Safety Audit'

issues.detail: The Land Stability Report (development on unstable or potentially unstable land, or involving excavation or mineral extraction) is merged into 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment'. That row's trigger is only the Coal Authority preamble, so the land stability trigger is lost.

Several tab_items are contact details, process text, boilerplate or fragments, not requirements. Items 7 and 9 are the phone number and email for general planning advice. Item 6 says 'pre-application advice will be charged for' (from the 2019 checklist). Item 12 is an HSE kitchen ventilation reference plus a 'Development Plan Policy' heading. Item 13 is a list of strategy document links. Item 17 is 'Number of copies of the form 17.'. Item 20 is 'Each local planning authority publishes their LDF on their own website'. Item 5 is process text from the 2019 checklist.

Many trigger excerpts are fragments lifted from other sections and do not say when the requirement applies. 'Landscaping scheme' uses the Airport Safeguarding text about bird-strike. 'Lighting Assessment' is 'pilots (see Lighting Impact Assessment/ Scheme)'. 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' is a bare cross-reference. 'Pre-application advice' is a bullet from the Affordable Housing statement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' and 'Archaeological Assessment' are bullets from the Heritage Statement content list. 'Transport Assessment' is 'with any Transport Statement or Transport Assessment that may be required'. 'Noise Impact Assessment' gives BS 8233 design criteria instead of the trigger. 'Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment' is 'determine their landscape and visual effects.'. 'Existing and proposed site levels' is a cut-off clause about extensions. 'Coal Mining' is the Coal Authority preamble, not the trigger (non-householder development in Development High Risk Areas).
issues.evidence: e.g. Explanatory Notes 'NOISE AND VIBRATION IMPACT ASSESSMENT When Required: new sensitive receptors exposed to existing noise/vibration sources... or new noise sources'

issues.detail: Two triggers are attached to the wrong requirement. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' under Advertisement consent uses the Lighting Impact Assessment trigger, which is a lighting assessment and not advertisement drawings. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' under Minerals & waste uses the 'Landfill Applications' trigger, which is about waste management and disposal applications and not refuse storage. Stockport is also a metropolitan borough, not a county.
issues.evidence: 'LANDFILL APPLICATIONS When Required Applications for waste management and disposal...'

issues.detail: 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' under Full planning have the identical trigger, both from the single 'Foul Drainage Assessment and Surface Water Drainage Assessment' item. 'Floor plans / Elevations' appears twice. tab_items 7 and 9 repeat the same phone/email line.
issues.evidence: both rows quote 'FOUL DRAINAGE ASSESSMENT AND SURFACE WATER DRAINAGE ASSESSMENT When Required Where the development involves the disposal of trade waste...'

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current Stockport list, the Explanatory Notes adopted 19 June 2024, and it works, though the List date should be 19 June 2024 and not 1 June. The extraction is weak. It ignores the 2024 checklist's per-application-type lists, so Householder, Reserved Matters, LBC, LDC, S73, discharge of conditions and NMA all show '(none)'. It omits Green Belt, Airport Safeguarding, the House Extension Energy Checklist and other local items, and it mixes in 2019-checklist and 2010 national-guidance text as tab items.
